image_description: A rustic, semi-outdoor industrial workshop scene featuring a large, weathered concrete wall in the background. In the foreground and mid-ground, there is heavy machinery including a bandsaw setup with a long metal track, raw logs awaiting processing, and processed wooden planks. A vertical wooden post with a green metal arm extends into the frame from the left. The floor is dirt or concrete covered in sawdust and wood debris. The lighting appears natural but diffuse.
